shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; git status --short; rg --files .lore specs src | rg 'acceptance|dod|AGENTS|spec-links|chatOrchestrator'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la .lore; rg --files scripts/spec-links; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,180p' .github/workflows/ci.yml; sed -n '1,100p' jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts; sed -n '1,90p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/toolBudget.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/|@spec|SPEC' src/orchestration/toolBudget.test.ts src/config.test.ts eslint.config.mjs | head -90; ls node_modules/.bin/jest node_modules/.bin/prettier"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,105p' src/providers/vertex/vertexProvider.ts; sed -n '1,90p' src/providers/bedrock/bedrockProvider.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/providers/withRetry.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/providers/vertex/vertexProvider.test.ts; cat tsconfig.json; rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|validated by' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | tail -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#([0-9]+|[a-z])'"' src scripts | head -50; sed -n '145,180p' eslint.config.mjs; sed -n '1,120p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain=v1"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; cat .lore/dod.md; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | head -15; git remote -v'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): pin non-Error hook rejections" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status -sb'
